versions.name: Camp Iyataka
versions.summary: A wooded, primitive Sioux Council camp near Wilmot in northeastern South Dakota, with developed and primitive campsites, a lodge, a lake beach, and trails for year-round unit and weekend camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Sioux Council Properties camp page (adventurebeginshere.org), which lists Camp Iyataka as a currently reservable council property offering year-round outdoor camping. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; US Census returned no match for the rural address); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council properties site; classified conservatively as a short-term/weekend camping property; features unsurveyed.
